Dated legacy snapshot ids on the page (gpt-4o-2024-05-13, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, gpt-4-0613, gpt-3.5-turbo-0125, gpt-3.5-turbo-1106, gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct) and the base completion models davinci-002 and babbage-002 are not included: this file records undated model ids, and adding pinned snapshots is a scope change rather than a price refresh. Note gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 and gpt-4-0613 would give azure-openai.json's gpt-4-turbo and gpt-4 entries a first-party cross-check they currently lack.

Exact effective dates are still not published for any rate. Periods first recorded on 2026-08-05 keep their conservative effectiveFrom of 2026-01-01; periods that changed or appeared since use the observation date, since the earlier observation proves they did not hold before it.
